item.title: 5 Feature-Rich Terminal Alternatives for macOS Power Users and Developers in 2026
item.summary: For many macOS users, the built-in Terminal still provides enough functionality for day-to-day work. But if you regularly work with SSH sessions, remote servers, containers, large logs, or multiple projects at once, its capabilities quickly become insufficient. That’s why many developers with system administrators are switching to modern Mac terminal emulator solutions.
